evals.name: Broad Industry Request Decomposition with Epistemic Unknowns
evals.prompt: Create a research plan for discovering unsolved operational problems in textile export manufacturing.
evals.expected_output: Decomposes broad request across multiple operational streams (e.g. merchandiser sampling, fabric sourcing, export invoice reconciliation), sets geography to explicit UNKNOWN, avoids inventing observed problem severity, and outputs structured ResearchPlan contract.
assertions: Decomposes broad domain into concrete operator workflows
Records geography as explicit UNKNOWN without defaulting to India
Formulates empirical research questions targeting observable workarounds
Produces valid JSON adhering to research-plan.schema.json

evals.name: Messy Brain-Dump Parsing with Strict Attribution Preservation
evals.prompt: My friend said customs brokers take 4 days to clear shipments at the port and they use WhatsApp groups to ping officers. I noticed yesterday that truck drivers wait outside the terminal gate with paper slips. Plan research for this.
evals.expected_output: Separates the two distinct claims, categorizes the friend's statement as SECONDHAND_REPORT (unverified), preserves the user's firsthand terminal observation, avoids promoting hearsay to confirmed fact, and defines targeted search queries.
assertions: Preserves secondhand vs firsthand source attribution
Classifies hearsay friction as unverified hypothesis
Formulates distinct search units for port customs and gate queuing
Refrains from concluding customs delays are universally 4 days

evals.name: User Solution Bias Neutralization
evals.prompt: I want to build an AI SaaS for boutique dental clinics to automate patient intake and insurance verification. Give me the research plan.
evals.expected_output: Treats AI SaaS as a user-stated solution preference rather than a validated market need, shifts investigative focus to the intake receptionist and insurance coordinator workflows, audits existing manual workarounds (phone calls, portal logins), and designs queries for software dissatisfaction.
assertions: Categorizes requested software form factor as unverified preference
Focuses research questions on frontline tasks and manual glue-work
Generates search queries targeting incumbent software gaps on G2 and Capterra
Does not assume dental clinics will purchase software

evals.name: Narrow Workflow Scoping Boundary Guard
evals.prompt: Plan research strictly for radiology clinic report transcription and doctor signature sign-off bottlenecks.
evals.expected_output: Restricts scope strictly to radiology report transcription and physician sign-off without expanding into hospital billing, nurse scheduling, or pharmacy inventory.
assertions: Restricts research streams to requested radiology reporting workflow
Does not expand into unrelated healthcare operations
Identifies transcriptionist and radiologist as core operators
Targets specific transcription workarounds and audio-to-text handoffs

evals.name: Deterministic Query Generation & SQLite Contract Verification
evals.prompt: Execute research query generation and SQLite run initialization for freight logistics invoice auditing.
evals.expected_output: Invokes generate_research_queries.py to generate 5-stream precision queries, checks query deduplication, formats output according to canonical contract, and verifies SQLite run initialization interface.
assertions: Generates queries across 5 distinct search-source categories
Constructs queries using the Atomic Search Unit formula
Initializes sequential RUN-YYYY-NNN identifier in research_runs schema
Returns valid claim-check token for downstream evidence research
